summary: Frontend-only verification of the newly converted Rupiah MoneyInput fields (static build, admin@ + finance@, entity KSC). 14 monetary fields verified live: pr-price-0, price-amount-input, cash-amount-input, vb-item-price-0, lc-line-amount-0, return-item-price-0, blanket-item-price-0, ca-line-price-0, stl-line-amount-0, tax-pph-modal-dpp, interco-contract-rate, rfq-quote-price-L1 (+ makloon-tariff-input typed). ALL rendered as type=text inputMode=decimal with the 'Rp' prefix inside the box and a live preview at `${testId}-preview` ('Rp 150.000', 'Rp 125.000', 'Rp 2.500.000', 'Rp 10.000.000' ...). No blank screens, ZERO React/console errors on any screen visited. Derived totals recompute correctly from the string values (PR total Rp 75.000.000 -> Rp 1.500.000 after qty 10; CA total Rp 250.000 = 2 x 125.000; LPJ Rp 450.000; PPh terutang Rp 200.000 from DPP 10.000.000; landed cost total Rp 2.500.000). Persistence verified end-to-end on 3 saves: PR-00009 est_price 150000 (list shows Rp 1.500.000), supplier price entry Rp 125.000 (SUP-00007 Daftar Harga), cash transaction KSC/CASH-00045 -Rp 275.000. vb-item-price-0 correctly disabled when the line checkbox is unchecked and enabled when checked. finance@ login works and Meja Finance renders without crash. TWO real defects found (Makloon wizard NOT converted / is the live path; Interco contract wizard selects wired with wrong prop).

ui_bugs.issue: LIVE 'Buat Order Makloon' path is MakloonWizard (data-testid=makloon-wizard), NOT MakloonOrderCreateModal. Its monetary fields are still plain <input className="field"> with no Rp prefix / no preview: 'wizard-material-price' (Harga Beli Bahan Rp/unit), 'wizard-rate-{n}' (Tarif Rp per basis), 'wizard-aux-amount-{n}-{i}' (biaya tambahan Rp). The converted MakloonOrderCreateModal.jsx (mko-material-price / mko-tariff) is only imported by features/admin/PurchaseOrderManagement.jsx, so the conversion effort did not reach the screen users actually use (also reached from PrSourcingPanel).

KNSelect is given `onChange={setSeller}` / `onChange={setBuyer}` / `onChange={setProductId}` but KNSelect only calls `onValueChange`. Verified in UI: after clicking an option the trigger 'PT Penjual (penerbit kontrak)' still reads 'Pilih...' -> state never updates, so 'Terbitkan Kontrak Internal' can never be completed. (MoneyInput 'interco-contract-rate' itself works: Rp 88.000 preview.)

Inconsistent conversion inside the SAME wizard: the credit picker uses MoneyInput (cb-create-cred-amount-*) but the bill amount column is still `<input type="number" step={1000}>` (cb-create-amount-{billId}) with no Rp prefix/preview.

critical_code_review_comments: MoneyInput/DecimalInput wrapper is correct: value kept as raw string, parseDecimal used only for the preview, min=0 visual validation, 'Rp' span is pointer-events-none with z-10 and paddingLeft 34 so it never blocks typing — no regression observed in 14 fields.

A converted file is worthless if it is not on the live route: MakloonOrderCreateModal vs MakloonWizard shows the bash/manual sweep matched filenames, not the render tree. Grep the import graph (AppViewRouter + view components) when auditing the remaining fields.
KNSelect only honours onValueChange; any call site using onChange silently no-ops. Worth a repo-wide grep for `<KNSelect` + `onChange=` (InternalContractWizardModal is one confirmed victim).

rca_of_the_issue: Makloon: the previous conversion targeted MakloonOrderCreateModal.jsx by filename, but MakloonOrdersView.jsx and PrSourcingPanel.jsx import ./makloon/MakloonWizard, whose money fields (wizard-material-price, wizard-rate-*, wizard-aux-amount-*) were never touched — so the user-facing screen still shows bare numeric boxes. Interco: InternalContractWizardModal passes `onChange` to KNSelect, which destructures only `onValueChange` (components/KNSelect.jsx lines 147-190), so Radix's change callback is dropped and the controlled value stays '' — reproduced by opening Hutang Pemasok -> Antar Entitas -> interco-open-contract-btn, clicking interco-contract-seller and an option, then reading the trigger text ('Pilih...').
